title: DriftStop: Motivation Quotes
shortDescription: A quote on your lock screen, under the clock. Wisdom, exactly on time.
fullDescription:
Let a quote meet you every time you wake your phone.

DriftStop sends you a short, hard-hitting quote at moments you didn't plan — and that quote stays on your lock screen, under the clock.

Not soft. Not toxic positivity. A punch to the chest, not a hug.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN, UNDER THE CLOCK
The last quote you were sent sits on your lock screen, right under the clock. You don't even have to type your PIN — it's there the moment you wake the phone. No app to open, nothing to remember.

Trying to summon discipline on purpose is exhausting. So instead: one sentence, in front of you all day. From Rumi, from Yunus Emre, from the Stoics, from Ibn Khaldun, from proverbs that outlived empires. Stay in constant company with words that reach the mind and the heart, and drifting gets harder.

Completely silent: no sound, no vibration, no pop-up. One tap in Settings turns it off.

On newer Android versions that support lock screen widgets, you can put the quote there as a widget too. The home screen widget works on every device.

WHAT IT DOES
Most motivation apps hand you a feed and let you scroll. DriftStop does the opposite: a few quotes a day, delivered as reminders, left on your lock screen, then it gets out of your way. You choose how many and which hours. No streak to babysit, nothing to scroll.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• The latest quote on your lock screen — under the clock, silent, switchable
• Home screen and lock screen widgets
• 1,000 hand-picked quotes, bundled free — Stoics, Rumi, Yunus Emre, Imam Ali, Ibn Khaldun, samurai, world proverbs
• Daily motivational reminders at random times inside the hours you pick
• Themes you choose: Motivation, Discipline, Focus, Resilience, Peace, Wisdom, Reckoning, Legacy
• A calm home screen showing one quote at a time — no endless feed, no doom-scroll
• Your history: revisit what you have seen, or pull a random one back
• Favourites and one-tap sharing
• Turn any quote into a phone wallpaper and save it to your gallery
• Works fully offline. No login. No account required.

DRIFTSTOP PRO
Every install starts with 7 days of Pro — no card, no sign-up, nothing to cancel.
• 3,325+ premium quotes across 18 curated collections — Stoic philosophy, Ancient Greek thinkers, Eastern wisdom, Enlightenment writers, literature and poetry, historical trailblazers
• Browse the whole catalogue by author
• Up to 10 reminders a day instead of 5
• No ads
Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. An account is optional, and is only used to carry your Pro access and premium collections to a new phone.

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who wants daily motivation, stoic quotes, discipline and focus reminders — without another feed to scroll or another app demanding attention.

LANGUAGES
Interface: English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French and Italian. Quote text in English and Turkish.

Made to feel like a worn leather notebook — warm, dark, hand-drawn.

Stop drifting. Get back to work.
